IPC (src-tauri/src/commands/addons.rs):

  - Rejects behaviorHints.configurationRequired with a text error telling the user to open {url}/configure in a browser (L23-30).
  - Uses transport URL as identity: it updates in place if the same URL exists, otherwise appends (L33-41). A reconfigured addon with a different URL therefore becomes a duplicate.
  - Then calls persist_addons.
- addon_remove(transport_url) (L47-61) and addon_list() (L63-66, returns effective_addons) complete the set.
- Commands are registered in src-tauri/src/lib.rs L54-79. TS wrappers are in src/lib/ipc.ts L27-31; the Descriptor/Manifest types are in src/lib/types.ts L35-53. src/lib/store.tsx useAddons() reloads them.

gaps: No addon directory/marketplace at all: the only way to install is pasting a URL. AddonCatalogResponse and the bundled Cinemeta addonCatalogs (all/community, all/official) are parsed but never used.

No third-party directory client (stremio-addons.net) and no listing index or cache. Even if one existed, the webview cannot fetch remote JSON because CSP connect-src is ipc only, so the work must be a new Rust module plus IPC commands.
No browsing UX: no tabs (built-in / installed / browse), search, type/resource/category facets, sort (stars/newest/A-Z), detail page, stars/'New' badges or attribution.
No adult gating setting (Harbor: showAdultAddons default false + age gate + adult-filter.ts) and no P2P filter. Today p2p/adult are shown only as badges inside the confirm dialog and card.

Configurable addons: configurationRequired returns a text error (commands/addons.rs L23-30). configurable-but-optional addons silently install the default with no 'Configure…' option. Installed addons cannot be reconfigured. No paste-back or clipboard flow, and stremio:// is not registered (schemes []).
Identity is transport URL only, so a reconfigured addon (new URL, same manifest.id) installs as a duplicate. There is no id-match/hostname-match 'replace' like Harbor's install-modal.tsx L58-93.
No reorder command/UI, although install order is the user's priority order for meta precedence and stream-group order (fanout.rs L75-78).

No update detection. Installed manifests are frozen snapshots in addons.json, so new catalogs/resources or a version bump never appear and capability changes (e.g. an addon starting to declare p2p) are never surfaced.
Installed list renders the full transport URL (Addons.tsx L196), exposing credentials embedded in configured URLs. Harbor masks it with Reveal (addon-detail.tsx L65-72, L361-411).
normalize_transport_input does not accept '/configure', '/#/configure' or URLs missing '/manifest.json' (Harbor parseAddonUrl handles all three).
Relative manifest logos are dropped (Manifest.logo: Option<Url> DefaultOnError). Harbor resolves them against the transport URL (addon-logo.tsx resolveAddonLogo).

Remote addon_catalog entries deserialize straight into Descriptor including flags.official/protected. If a directory entry were ever persisted directly, a remote listing could mark itself 'protected', which makes it unremovable from the UI. Directory data needs its own type that strips flags.

implementation_plan.step: 1. Directory types, parsers and client in the protocol crate
implementation_plan.details:
New module crates/zeiler-addon/src/directory.rs (re-exported from lib.rs).

Types:
- `enum DirectorySource { StremioCommunity, StremioOfficial, StremioAddonsNet }`
- `struct DirectoryEntry { key: String /* manifest.id */, manifest: Manifest /* listing snapshot, display only */, transport_url: Url, sources: Vec<DirectorySource>, stars: Option<u32>, categories: Vec<Category{name, slug}>, listed_at: Option<String>, updated_at: Option<String>, slug: Option<String>, site_url: Option<Url>, adult: bool, p2p: bool, configurable: bool, configuration_required: bool }`
- Lenient serde mirrors of the stremio-addons.net shapes: SaAddon {uuid, url, manifestUrl, manifest, slug, stars, categories, configureUrl, createdAt, updatedAt, documentation?}, SaList {addons, pagination{page, limit, total, totalPages, hasNextPage, hasPreviousPage}}, SaCategories {categories}. Use VecSkipError/DefaultOnError like the rest of the crate.

Client methods:
- Add `AddonClient::addon_catalog(transport, type, id) -> AddonCatalogResponse` via the existing resource() with ResourcePath::new("addon_catalog", "all", "community"|"official") against the Cinemeta transport URL. This is protocol-native, so no new host is hard-coded beyond Cinemeta.
- Make get_json pub(crate) so `DirectoryClient::{list_page(page, limit, nsfw), detail(slug), categories()}` keep the 20 MB cap and the Zeiler UA.

Normalisation:
- Validate every entry with validate_transport_url and drop failures.
- Convert addon_catalog Descriptors into DirectoryEntry and DISCARD their flags.
- Dedupe by manifest.id, merging sources and keeping stremio-addons.net stars/categories.
- Port Harbor's src/lib/addons-store/adult-filter.ts into directory/adult.rs (MIT header, attribution): is_adult_text(fields).
- adult = manifest.behaviorHints.adult || category slug 'nsfw' || is_adult_text(id, name). p2p = manifest.behaviorHints.p2p (self-declared; documented as such).
- Do not port Harbor's DEBRID_RX/curated categorisation or bundled stream-brand logos.

implementation_plan.step: 2. Marketplace index cache and IPC commands
implementation_plan.details:
New src-tauri/src/commands/marketplace.rs, registered in lib.rs generate_handler.

AppState gets `market: RwLock<Option<MarketIndex{entries, categories, fetched_at, failures}>>`:
- TTL 1 h, mirrored to cache_dir/marketplace-index.json for fast start and offline.
- Build mirrors Harbor stremio-addons-index.ts: stremio-addons.net pages 1..=6 × limit 100, sort_by=stars, order=desc, nsfw=exclude unless show_adult_addons (then refetch without it), joined with Cinemeta addon_catalog all/community and all/official, all fetched in parallel.
- Partial failures are kept per source and returned to the UI. Errors carry only the host, never full URLs.

Commands:
- `marketplace_list(query: MarketQuery{search?, types: Vec<String>, resources: Vec<String> /* stream|subtitles|catalog|meta|addon_catalog */, category?: String, sort: "stars"|"newest"|"name", page, limit}) -> MarketPage{entries: Vec<MarketEntryView>, total, hasMore, sourcesOk, sourcesFailed, fetchedAt}`.
  - Filtering is local, using manifest.types plus object-form resource types, resource names (catalog when catalogs is non-empty), category slug, and search over name/description/id/slug.
  - Adult entries are always dropped unless settings.show_adult_addons. P2P entries are dropped only when settings.hide_p2p_addons.
  - MarketEntryView adds installState: "builtIn"|"installed"|"available", computed against effective_addons by manifest.id OR transport URL. Built-in Cinemeta shows as Built-in, never Install.
- `marketplace_categories()` uses /api/v0/categories, falls back to Harbor's 16 default slugs, and hides 'nsfw' unless adult is enabled.
- `marketplace_detail(key) -> {entry, documentation: Option<String> /* plain text */}` uses GET /api/v0/addons/{slug}.
- `marketplace_refresh()` forces a rebuild.
- No fetch happens until settings.marketplace_enabled is true.

Add to Settings (state.rs, serde camelCase, default):
- `marketplace_enabled: bool = false`: opt-in. The first visit to Browse shows a notice: 'Listings come from stremio-addons.net and Stremio's public addon catalog. Zeiler doesn't review, rank or endorse them. Install only what you trust.'
- `marketplace_sources: {stremio_addons_net: bool = true, stremio_catalog: bool = true}`
- `show_adult_addons: bool = false`
- `hide_p2p_addons: bool = false`: P2P is flagged by default, not hidden. This is a product decision; flip the default if the owner prefers hidden.
- `stremio_deep_link: bool = false`

Mirror the keys in src/lib/types.ts Settings. Expose them in Settings → Content under a new 'Addon directory' SectionCard next to the Cinemeta toggle (Settings.tsx ContentSection L347-382).

risks: stremio-addons.net /api/v0 is an undocumented, unversioned third-party API. Its shape may change, it may rate-limit, or its operator may object to client apps. Check the ToS or ask the operator first, cache for 1 h, and degrade to Stremio's addon_catalog alone. The response shapes here come from Harbor's TypeScript types and were NOT live-verified: this container's proxy returns 403 for stremio-addons.net, v3-cinemeta.strem.io and api.strem.io.

Content-neutrality perception: the directory's top-starred entries are mostly stream/torrent/debrid addons. Mitigations: opt-in (marketplace_enabled=false), a neutral sort, no featured rails, hero or recommendations, a persistent 'not curated by Zeiler' label, and installs only through the manifest confirmation dialog. The owner should approve the opt-in default and the P2P default (flagged vs hidden).

Listing data is untrusted, including name, description, logo, documentation and the manifest snapshot. Render as text only (no rehype-raw, unlike Harbor addon-documentation.tsx). Always refetch the live manifest at install and diff it against the listing. Never persist listing Descriptors: remote flags.official/protected must be dropped.

Adult detection is heuristic. behaviorHints.adult and the 'nsfw' category are self-declared, and the ported term list (e.g. 'explicit', 'uncensored', 'hardcore') gives both false negatives and false positives. Keep the 'Show adult' override and the server-side nsfw=exclude as a second layer.

p2p is self-declared too; many torrent addons may not set behaviorHints.p2p, so a 'Hide P2P' filter is incomplete. Label the flag as declared by the addon, and don't add Zeiler-side name heuristics like Harbor's DEBRID_RX, which hard-codes stream-addon names against CONTRIBUTING.md.

Privacy: browsing the directory exposes the user's IP to stremio-addons.net, strem.io and every logo host, because img-src allows https: and http:. Only fetch after opt-in, and only when the Browse tab is opened.

Transport URLs embed credentials. Update checks and reconfigure flows touch them, so keep them out of logs and error strings. reqwest::Error's Display can include the URL, so map errors to host-only messages. Mask URLs in the UI by default.

Registering the stremio:// scheme can take it over from an installed Stremio app. Keep it opt-in and reversible (unregister). On macOS, runtime registration may not be supported by tauri-plugin-deep-link without static Info.plist schemes; unverified.
Reorder changes meta precedence (first_meta) and stream-group order. This is intended, but users may be surprised, so document it in the UI.

Client-side facet filtering over a capped index (about 600 stremio-addons.net entries plus the Stremio catalog) can miss long-tail addons. Mitigate by passing search through to the server's search param when the local index has no hits.
Update checks fan out to every addon host. Throttle (6 h, concurrency 6, 10 s timeout) to avoid hammering self-hosted or free-tier addons.
